facts.text: Under the Concordia Texas Promise, eligible students with significant financial need from Travis, Williamson, and Hays counties receive full coverage of remaining tuition costs after financial aid is applied.

sources.title: Concordia Texas Promise - Concordia University Texas
sources.quote: This scholarship program covers the remaining tuition costs after federal, state, and other institutional aid is applied, ensuring that you can focus on your studies without the burden of unmet tuition expenses.
